summary.semantic: Current rematerializes the accepted D03 Stable Core baseline at main@6bda1e87 with 21 existing component identities. Planned keeps the same components, boundaries, geometry, and connection topology while broadening the existing Canonical Guidance / Lifecycle / Execution / Git / Verification / Archify responsibilities to close exact DeliveryOperationId → content-bound DeliveryGuidanceRef → minimal DeliveryOperationPackage execution, state-first continuity, Formal Full Test correction, architecture/finalization, and repository/next-base continuity. No Registry, Router, Planner, second Delivery lifecycle, Agent Skill discovery layer, mandatory transport subsystem, or new control-plane component is added.
summary.presentation: Current and Planned intentionally retain the same component graph. D04 is shown as responsibility/contract convergence across existing seams rather than artificial component churn.
